dashboard.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Data Health and SLA
dashboard.description: Contract breaches ranked by blast radius, not by alphabetical order.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup where status="active" | lookup dc_contracts_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT max_silence_minutes expected_events_min sla_response_minutes notify_channel | `dc_default_silence` | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen events_24h | lookup dc_baselines_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT median_events mad_events | eval silence_minutes=if(isnull(last_seen),99999,round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)) | eval state=case(silence_minutes>max_silence_minutes,"DATA_DOWN", isnotnull(median_events) AND events_24h<(median_events-4*mad_events),"VOLUME_LOW", isnotnull(median_events) AND events_24h>(median_events+8*mad_events),"VOLUME_SPIKE",1=1,"OK") | where state!="OK" AND declared_tier="Tier 0" | eval sla_breach_in_min=round(sla_response_minutes-silence_minutes,0) | table dataset_id ae_name index sourcetype state silence_minutes events_24h median_events technical_owner business_owner notify_channel | sort - silence_minutes

| inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup where status="active" | `dc_default_silence` | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen | eval silence_minutes=if(isnull(last_seen),99999,round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)) | eval state=case(isnull(last_seen),"NEVER_SEEN",silence_minutes>max_silence_minutes,"DATA_DOWN",1=1,"OK") | chart count over declared_tier by state

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup where status="active" | `dc_default_silence` | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen | eval silence_minutes=if(isnull(last_seen),99999,round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)) | where silence_minutes>max_silence_minutes | join type=left dataset_id [| inputlookup dc_dependencies_lookup where dep_type="dataset" | rename dep_value as dataset_id | lookup dc_ko_lookup ko_id OUTPUT ko_tier ko_type | stats dc(eval(if(ko_type="correlation_search",ko_id,null()))) as detections_impacted, dc(eval(if(ko_type="dashboard",ko_id,null()))) as dashboards_impacted, dc(eval(if(ko_tier="Tier 0",ko_id,null()))) as tier0_objects_impacted by dataset_id] | fillnull value=0 detections_impacted dashboards_impacted tier0_objects_impacted | table dataset_id ae_name sourcetype declared_tier silence_minutes tier0_objects_impacted detections_impacted dashboards_impacted technical_owner | sort - tier0_objects_impacted - detections_impacted
